coverage_notes: OCHA OPT was checked first and WHO second. Twelve additional targeted searches were completed across Reuters, AP, WAFA, UNRWA, WFP, UNICEF, ICRC, MSF, medical evacuation/hospital/fuel, crossings/aid access, ceasefire/hostages/negotiations, and military operations with civilian impact. No new traceable development was verified inside the bounded window. A September 30 Reuters/GMA report described September 29 Gaza City and Jabalia strikes already captured by earlier recall checks and was excluded as duplicate. A September 30 UN News syndication referred to Israeli fire near UN facilities and humanitarian convoys 'in recent days' without a verifiable new event inside this hourly window and had already surfaced in the prior watch context, so it was excluded. No search/source failure materially reduced coverage.
